✅ Correct Answer: B — Al Pease

📖 Explanation:

Canadian driver Al Pease holds this unique and unwanted record from the 1969 Canadian Grand Prix at Mosport Park.

Driving an outdated Eagle T1G, Pease was running extremely off the pace and had completed only 22 laps by the time the race leaders were already on lap 46.

After causing multiple on-track incidents and nearly colliding with race leader Jackie Stewart, he was red- or black-flagged out of the race following a protest from Tyrrell team boss Ken Tyrrell.
